templates.account_positioning: Academic productivity account using familiar research interfaces, status-upgrade hooks, and simple screen-recorded workflows to make research tools feel immediately useful.
templates.main_content_logic: Status-gap hook -> strong website CTA -> short command chain -> tip/proof setup -> finished academic output proof.

visible_sequence: How to write your thesis paper like a PhD/Master student (The easy way)
Pro tip! use latex for pdfs
Then watch it do its magic in 2-3 mins
caption_logic.punctuation_pattern: Status-upgrade hook with parenthetical qualifier, exclamation CTA, short command captions, Pro tip!, ellipsis before reveal, exclamation result proof.
caption_logic.hook_formula: How to [do academic task] like a [higher-status academic identity] ([easy/smart/legit way])
caption_logic.reuse_rule: Preserve status-gap hook, early CTA, command chain, reveal setup, and proof ending. Replace unsupported time/completion claims with product-safe proof.

rewrite_boundaries: Do not imply the product writes a complete paper for submission.
Do not copy Google Scholar branding as product affiliation.
Replace exact time promises with safer phrases unless measured.
Keep the sentence rhythm and roles, not the original claims.

templates.account_positioning: Student-life creator using fear, casual confession, and quick laptop proof to make an academic workflow shortcut feel like an insider tip.
templates.main_content_logic: Authority warning or student fear -> creator reaction/confession -> one-step tool action -> fast result proof -> emotional release.

visible_sequence: My professor said he can tell if we use AI for our assignments...
So I check my sources first
and boom, now I know what to fix 😭
caption_logic.punctuation_pattern: Lowercase casual confession, quoted authority warning, ellipsis after fear setup, and boom result reveal, emoji at relief moment.
caption_logic.reuse_rule: Preserve fear-to-relief rhythm. Rewrite unsafe bypass/detector logic into ethical checking, verifying, organizing, or editing support.

rewrite_boundaries: Do not promise bypassing AI detection.
Keep the human anxiety hook, but convert the action into ethical review or verification.
Use one clear proof moment instead of a long feature tour.

templates.account_positioning: Student/research productivity account using late-night academic pain, handheld paper/laptop proof, and emotional relief to frame research workflows as time-saving study help.
templates.main_content_logic: Sleepless-night pain hook -> tool value promise -> simple topic input -> relevant paper/result proof -> finished starting point -> relief ending.

visible_sequence: saying goodbye to my sleepless night because i can now start my rrl faster 🥹🥹🥹
this gives me research papers that are curated and relevant 🧑‍💻✨
just type your topic and let it find the papers 🪄✨
my review finally has a starting point, goodnight world 🥱💤
caption_logic.punctuation_pattern: All lowercase, emotional student phrasing, short lines, cute emojis, soft no-hard-sell CTA, relief ending.
caption_logic.hook_formula: saying goodbye to my [study pain] because i can now [safe progress outcome]
caption_logic.reuse_rule: Preserve lowercase emotional study rhythm and relief arc. Replace exact time/quantity promises with safe measured or softer claims.

rewrite_boundaries: Do not promise a full assignment, RRL, or paper is finished automatically.
Do not use exact time claims unless verified.
Keep the late-night pain and relief emotion, but frame the result as a starting point or checked workflow.
Use emojis sparingly and only where the template expects emotional release.
